info.name: October backend
info.description:
Weekend recommender + status (FastAPI, port 8000) and Sloth Trip Watcher (Node.js, port 3000).

Set `baseUrl` / `slothBaseUrl` for your environment. Interactive FastAPI docs are at `{{baseUrl}}/docs` and the OpenAPI schema at `{{baseUrl}}/openapi.json`.

FastAPI errors are `{ detail: string }` (400/502) or `{ detail: [ ... ] }` (422 validation). Both apps send CORS headers (`CORS_ORIGIN`, default `*`), so a browser frontend on another origin can call them.

item.name: Weekend recommender
item.description: Asks 'What should I do this weekend?', then location and time available, and recommends one nearby place using weather, nearby places and local news.

item.name: Chat flow
item.description:
Conversation endpoint. Send the requests in order; each reply tells the frontend what to show next.

Request body: `{ "session_id": string | null, "message": string | null }` (message max 300 chars)

Response: `{ session_id, stage, reply, plan }`
- `stage` is what the API is waiting for: `location` → `duration` → `done`.
- `reply` is text to show the user.
- `plan` is null until `stage` is `done`, then it holds the full recommendation (same shape as `/weekend/recommend` without `summary`).

Sessions live in server memory for 1 hour and are lost on restart. An unknown/expired `session_id` simply starts a new conversation.
When `stage` is `done`, sending another location starts a new recommendation in the same session.

⏱ The final step can take a few seconds with Gemini, or several minutes when the server falls back to local Ollama. Use a long client timeout (5 min) and show a loading state.

request.description:
Same recommendation in a single call, for UIs that collect location and duration in one form.

Body: `{ location: string (2-200 chars), duration: string (1-100 chars) }`

Response fields:
- `location`, `duration`, `hours`, `radius_km`
- `weather[]`: weekend days with `summary`, `max_c`, `min_c`, `rain_chance` (%), `rain_mm`, `sunrise`, `sunset`
- `places[]`: candidates with `distance_km`, `kind`, `description`, `wikipedia_url`, `notability`
- `news[]`: `title`, `source`, `published`, `link`
- `recommendation`: `place` (with `maps_url`), `day`, `when`, `why`, `plan[]`, `bring[]`, `news_notes[]`, `backups[]`, `decided_by`. `place` can be null if nothing was found nearby.
- `summary`: ready-to-show text

⏱ Set a 5-minute timeout.
